{{Quote|Captain, look!''"<br />"''Shields up!|Antidar Williams and Maoi Madakor's reaction to the droid|audio=WilliamsAndMadakor.flac|<ref name="TPM" />}}
'''Droid laser turrets''' were a type of [[turret droid]]<ref name="Complete Vehicles">[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2013)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'']]</ref> armed with a [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]].<ref name="Databank" /> They consisted of a [[Color/Legends|gray]] oblate spheroid body with two [[Barrel/Legends|barrels]] protruding from it and a trunk ascending from the top of the spheroid to the surface that the [[Turret/Legends|turret]] was attached to. A [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Laser turret/Legends|laser turret]] was concealed within the ceiling of a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] within the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]]<ref name="TPM" /> modified [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class LH-3210 cargo freighter]] [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']].<ref name="Complete Vehicles" />

During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockade]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="TPM" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], including the appearance of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Laser turret/Legends|laser turret]], to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> the turret descended and fired upon the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] [[Radiant VII/Legends|''Radiant VII'']] on the orders of [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]. The turret targeted the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser's]] [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]], destroying the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] and [[Death/Legends|killing]] its crew, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Maoi Madakor/Legends|Maoi Madakor]] and [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Antidar Williams/Legends|Antidar Williams]].<ref name="Complete Vehicles" />

==Behind the scenes==
A droid laser turret first appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> It was first identified in the [[2013]] reference book [[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2013)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'']].<ref name="Complete Vehicles" />
